revisionDesc.change: Finalized - In line 2 Balamoshev suggested reading Τινεύτιος instead of Τινο̣ύ̣τ̣ιος. Following Gonis, I decided not to incorporate this into the text. The name Τινοῦτις is attested for some 19 individual persons (TM Nam 12562). Τινεῦς is attested only once in the genitive Τινεῦτος in a securely read attestion (TM Nam 25824). In line 4 Balamoshev suggested the alternative reading κ̣α̣τ̣εστήσατο alongside ὑ̣πεστήσατο̣. I felt that there is too little space for κατ instead of ὑ̣π and that in comparison to κατὰ δὲ τὸ in line 6 the proposed reading of the letters κατ for κ̣α̣τ̣εστήσατο were too unconvincing.
